project: Team in a Box - Agent Swarms
description: Multi-agent swarm orchestration for Team in a Box platform. Enables Opus 4.6 orchestrators to coordinate Sonnet 4.5 workers for complex task execution.

userStories.title: Agent Swarm Orchestrator - Base Implementation
userStories.description: Create the core swarm coordinator class that manages multi-agent task execution
acceptance_criteria: Can create a swarm with 1 orchestrator + N workers
Task assignment and progress monitoring works
Messages flow between orchestrator and workers
Model routing assigns Opus vs Sonnet appropriately

userStories.title: Multi-Agent Chat Interface
userStories.description: Build real-time UI for viewing swarm activity, agent status, and message history
acceptance_criteria: Shows list of active swarms with status
Agent status cards display current work
Can filter messages by agent or type

userStories.title: Swarm Configuration Builder
userStories.description: UI to define agent roles, capabilities, task routing rules, and model assignments
acceptance_criteria: Can assign orchestrator and worker roles
Can define capabilities and routing rules

success_criteria: All 3 stories pass validation. Can create and run a working swarm via UI.
